content: जर्जर {%a.%} [जर्ज्-बा˚ अर] .²1 Old, infirm, decayed. .²2 Worn out, torn, shattered, broken to pieces, divided in parts, split up into thin particles; जराजर्जरितविषाणकोटयो मृगाः <ls>K. 21</ls>; गात्रं जराजर्जरितं विहाय <ls>Mv. 7. 18</ls>; विसर्पन् धाराभिर्लुठति धरणीं जर्जरकणः <ls>U. 1. 29</ls>; <ls>Śi. 4. 23</ls>; <ls>Māl. 9. 16</ls>. .²3 Wounded, hurt. .²4 Pained, tormented; <ls>Māl. 9. 53</ls>. .²5 Dull, hollow (as the sound of a broken vessel). .{@-रम्@} .²1 The banner of Indra. .²2 Moss.
